recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further core source work is needed for FHIR-32299 unless the work group later revisits the broader normative compatibility policy.
issue_request: FHIR-32299 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core change request, applied for R5, asking the normative forward/backward compatibility References row to say that adding extra allowed Reference or Canonical targets is compatible. The resolution was to add: "Additional resources or profiles can also be added to the list of available targets for a reference."
initial_application: Commit 7ddf9ac04d3a713e49aa2c8b519fe7675b4b67fa explicitly applied FHIR-32299 to source/versions.html by adding the requested sentence. The initial source hunk included the Jira-resolution lead-in "We will add the sentence:", but later cleanup history removed that lead-in while preserving the substantive rule.
additional_context: source/versions.html is the active Version Management Policy HTML source page and is marked Normative in its page header. Later issue FHIR-47643 appended a caveat about references to non-normative resources in the same References row; it refines rather than reverses FHIR-32299 and already has its own reconcile audit commit on the combined branch. Confluence FHIR-I WGM 202109 minutes record FHIR-32299 as Persuasive with an 8-0-0 vote, and targeted Zulip searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The combined branch already contains the approved FHIR-32299 sentence in source/versions.html, so a source edit would duplicate existing correct content.

related_jiras.note: Later Applied/Persuasive issue on the same References row appended the non-normative target-resource caveat; it is already represented on the combined branch and was treated as context, not decided here.
